evidence_against.relevance: Casey regularly initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks.
Casey invested time in Drew's important interview preparation and attended an important birthday dinner.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods of geographic separation.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting it, supporting low commitment.
Meetings were generally convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled advance plans for other commitments.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined a future event because it required planning ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew could ask Casey what level of involvement Casey is willing to offer and whether the relationship will be revisited, then compare the answer with Drew's needs.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's consistent initiation, practical support, and resumed contact show real interest and investment, but the repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience-oriented meetings, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement.
